I also dislike that large companies like SCJohnson, Proctor and Gamble, and Nestle basically have people convinced that they need to rely on their products to function in everyday life. Here is the 10 Companies that Control Your Life article. Lots of people have probably seen that chart, nothing new. It makes me so uncomfortable to look at it though.
